description: Calculate engagement rate from likes, comments, shares and followers or reach.

faqs.a: Enter likes, comments, shares and either follower count or reach. ER = (likes+comments+shares) ÷ followers (or reach) × 100.
Both are standard: by followers shows audience loyalty, by reach shows content performance. This tool computes both.
Roughly: <1% low, 1–3% average, 3–6% good, 6%+ excellent — varies by platform and niche.
faqs.q: What is a good engagement rate?

faqs.a: Use averages across your last 10–20 posts for a stable number, not a single viral post.
faqs.q: Should I use one post or an average?

howto: See ER by followers and by reach, with a rating.
title: Engagement Rate Calculator
